answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in saffron and vault lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the falcon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1213 impostors cost 996 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
